description: This file defines the Bluetooth Profile class and its nested Service and Characteristic classes, including UUIDs, descriptors, and methods for discovering and managing Bluetooth GATT services and characteristics within the WPEFramework Bluetooth namespace.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT profile, managing services and characteristics discovery.

classes.name: Profile::Service
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT service, containing characteristics.

classes.name: Profile::Service::Characteristic
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT characteristic, including descriptors and data handling.

classes.name: Profile::Service::Characteristic::Descriptor
classes.description: Represents a descriptor for a GATT characteristic.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers services and characteristics on a Bluetooth device within a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the profile discovery is valid and complete.

methods.name: Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over discovered services.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds characteristics within a service matching specific UUIDs.

methods.name: FindHandle
methods.description: Finds the handle of a characteristic or descriptor.

methods.name: OnServices
methods.description: Handles the response for service discovery.

methods.name: OnCharacteristics
methods.description: Handles the response for characteristics discovery.

methods.name: OnDescriptors
methods.description: Handles the response for descriptor discovery.

methods.name: OnAttribute
methods.description: Handles the response for attribute read.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Reports the result of discovery process.

methods.name: AvailableTime
methods.description: Calculates remaining time for discovery timeout.
